notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Sakashima the Impostor do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Sakashima the Impostor.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
